name: Language Models: Tokenloom
subtitle: Tokens, attention and scaling
shortDescription: Touch the equations behind language models: attention, scaling laws, KV caches and more.
longDescription:
Language Models: Tokenloom is a graduate-level course in how large language models are built, sized and run, designed for your phone. You do not just read equations. Every equation starts as a real situation you can touch: a reader's eye moving across a sentence, a shipping agent packing text into containers, a notebook of past tokens, a budget split between a bigger model and more text.

Eight units, fourteen hands-on labs:
- Tokenisation: train byte-pair merges and watch the token count fall.
- The Transformer block: a reading-eye attention heat map with a causal mask, and a parameter counter.
- Pretraining: a surprise meter for perplexity and a loss landscape you roll a ball down.
- Scaling laws: a compute budget planner and a power-law fitter with held-out extrapolation.
- Distributed training: memory per GPU across ZeRO stages, and utilisation.
- Inference: the key/value cache notebook, speculative decoding, and weight quantisation.
- Decoding: temperature, top-k and top-p as loaded dice.
- Evaluation: an exam-leak probe for contamination and a mixture-of-experts router.

After every lab you answer a question computed from the settings you just chose. A bank of more than 400 questions covers the course; generated answers are re-derived by separate verifier code, and every lesson card and concept question links to its source (papers such as the original Transformer, scaling-law and compute-optimal training papers, open textbook chapters, and public university course pages) with the exact section, in a sheet that opens over your lesson.

Short sessions of a few minutes, a gentle replay queue for missed questions, text size from 85% to 200%, no account, works offline (sources need a connection). Toy scale only: nothing here trains or runs a real language model.

Free with ads at natural breaks, never during a lab or quiz. Optional monthly ad-free subscription with a 7-day free trial; cancel any time in your store account settings, and cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle. You can also watch short videos to earn credits.

Written and source-checked by our team; not reviewed by an external expert. Content as of 2026-11-17. Not affiliated with any university or company named in the sources.
